title: AnchorPractitionerDetail
description: The Anchor Ops detail panel payload for one practitioner in one anchor group.

anchorGroupPractitionerId.description: Anchor group practitioner id — the key every write uses.

contributingTenantId.description: Tenant that contributed the platform date.

controlStatus.description: Who owns the date — AUTOMATIC or MANUAL. Null only on a row no writer has touched.

reviewStatus.description: Whether review is required — REQUIRED or NOT_REQUIRED. Null only on a row no writer has touched.

updatedAt.description: Last change to the row, by any writer.

updatedBy.description: The operator who last acted on this record. Not tied to updatedAt — the two describe different events. Null until an operator acts.

updatedByName.description: That operator's name, or email when no name is on file. Null when the lookup found nothing; the panel falls back to updatedBy.

lastOperatorActionAt.description: When that operator acted. Pairs with updatedBy — same audit event — not with updatedAt. Null until an operator acts.

reviewRaisedAt.description: When the platform raised the current review. Pairs with reviewStatus — not with updatedBy, who did not raise it. Null unless review is REQUIRED.

participatingTenants.description: Every tenant with a participation row under this record.

overrideActive.description: Whether an operator override is in force on this record.

operationalStatus.description: Operational status: AUTOMATIC, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, REVIEW_REQUIRED or NO_ANCHOR_YET.

platformEligibleTenantIds.description: Tenants the platform currently rates eligible for this practitioner.

AnchorTenantParticipation.description: One tenant's eligibility, participation and scheduling date for a practitioner.

eligible.description: Whether the platform currently rates this tenant eligible.

exclusionReason.description: Exclusion reason code when not eligible.

participating.description: Effective participation — the value the checkbox renders from.

participationOverride.description: Raw stored is_participating; null means 'follows eligibility'.

tenantSchedulingDateSource.description: Source of the stored scheduling date.
